mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a crisp 39 degrees with clear skies by Fireman's Park and a first quarter moon. The International Space Station will be visible for four minutes starting at 5:39 AM, rising over Mount Horeb and traveling high across the sky toward Fitchburg and Madison.

Our top story involves an arrest from last Thursday, where a school bus driver was taken into custody for operating while impaired. In other city updates, residents can use the interactive map on the city website to determine their specific zoning district and property standards. Additionally, the city has confirmed four primary polling locations for upcoming elections, including the Public Library and City Hall.

There is plenty to do in our community today, starting with the Dane County Farmer's Market at the Capitol. You can also catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, mark your calendars for Yoga at Insight Wellness on October 19, and trivia nights at the Hop Haus and The Bogey Factory starting October 20.
On Thursday, October 15, the Verona Police Department responded to a report of dangerous driving and arrested a school bus driver for an O W I incident near Whalen Road and Fairview Terrace.
For dessert lovers, today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Volcano. The store is currently closed, but will open today at 10:00 AM.
